detail.text: I need to read the repository structure and AGENTS.md to understand the conventions before creating a plan.

Now I have a complete understanding of the repository structure. Let me create the plan.

```json
{
  "summary": "Build a notes app with accounts, notes with tags, search, pinning, and sharing. The foundation card establishes the SQLite store interface, session middleware, and server constructor that all feature cards extend via routes_<key>.go files. Feature cards add auth, notes CRUD with tags, listing/search/pinning, and sharing independently. The integration card wires acceptance tests A1-A9 against the assembled server.",
  "cards": [
    {
      "key": "foundation",
      "role": "foundation",
      "title": "Store interface, session middleware, migrations and server wiring",
      "brief": "Set up the application's core contracts that every feature card builds on.

**Store**: define `internal/store.Store` interface with methods `CreateUser`, `GetUserByUsername`, `CreateSession`, `GetSession`, `DeleteSession`, `CreateNote`, `GetNote`, `ListNotes`, `UpdateNote`, `DeleteNote`, `PinNote`, `UnpinNote`, `CreateShare`, `GetShare`, `RevokeShare`, `ListTags`. Implementation in `internal/store/sqlite.go` using `modernc.org/sqlite`, opened at `$DATA_DIR/notes.db`. Embed migrations from `migrations/` named by UTC timestamp; run them on open.

**Session middleware**: `internal/server/auth.go` exports `currentUser(r *http.Request) (userID int64, ok bool)` reading the HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie. Handlers call it; unauthenticated requests to `/api/*` (except signup/login) answer 401.

**Server constructor**: extend `internal/server.New(server.Config)` to open the store and pass it to route registrations. Each feature card adds its own `routes_<key>.go` calling a register function.

**Migration**: `migrations/<timestamp>_init.sql` creates tables users, sessions, notes, note_tags, shares.

One end-to-end test in `internal/server/server_test.go` verifying New returns a handler and /healthz works with a real store.",
      "directories": ["internal/store", "internal/server", "migrations"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestServer: GET /healthz answers 200 with status ok after store init"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "auth",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Sign up, log in, log out and GET /api/me",
      "brief": "Implement authentication endpoints and frontend pages.

**API** (`internal/server/routes_auth.go`):
- POST /api/signup: validate username `[a-z0-9_]{3,20}`, password >= 10 chars, bcrypt hash, create user, set session cookie.
- POST /api/login: verify credentials, set session cookie.
- POST /api/logout: delete session, clear cookie.
- GET /api/me: return current user or 401.

Cookie: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/.

**Frontend** (`web/src/pages/Login.tsx`, `Signup.tsx`): forms posting to the API, redirecting to /app/notes on success. Update `App.tsx` routes.

Tests: unit tests in `routes_auth_test.go` using httptest and the store; frontend tests with mockFetch.",
      "directories": ["internal/server", "web/src/pages", "web/src"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestSignupLoginMe: sign up, GET /api/me returns username", "TestLogout: after logout GET /api/me answers 401"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "notes-crud",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Notes CRUD with tags and validation",
      "brief": "Implement note creation, reading, updating, deletion with tag handling.

**API** (`internal/server/routes_notes.go`):
- POST /api/notes: title 1-200 chars, body <= 20000 chars, tags 0-10 each `[a-z0-9-]{1,30}` after lowercasing, deduplicate. Return created note with id, timestamps.
- GET /api/notes/<id>: return note or 404 if not owner's.
- PUT /api/notes/<id>: same validation, update only owner's note, else 404.
- DELETE /api/notes/<id>: delete owner's note, else 404.
- GET /api/tags: list user's tags with note counts.

Validation errors answer 400 with details.

**Frontend** (`web/src/pages/NoteEditor.tsx`): form with title, body textarea, tag input, save/delete buttons.

Tests cover validation (201-char title -> 400, bad tag -> 400, 11 tags -> 400), ownership (other user -> 404), tag deduplication.",
      "directories": ["internal/server", "internal/store", "web/src/pages"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestCreateNoteWithTags: tags Go,go,work stored as go,work", "TestValidation: 201-char title answers 400", "TestOwnership: other user GET/PUT/DELETE answers 404"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "listing-search",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Note listing with pagination, tag filter, search and pinning",
      "brief": "Implement listing, search, filtering and pin ordering.

**API** (extend `internal/server/routes_notes.go` or add `routes_listing.go`):
- GET /api/notes: list user's notes, most recently updated first, 20 per page (?page=1). Filter by ?tag=<tag> and ?q=<text> (case-insensitive substring of title or body), combinable. Response includes notes array and total count. Pinned notes come first within their group, each group sorted by updated desc.
- POST /api/notes/<id>/pin: pin note.
- DELETE /api/notes/<id>/pin: unpin note.

**Frontend** (`web/src/pages/Notes.tsx`): list with search box, tag dropdown, pagination controls, pin toggle. Pinned notes visually distinguished.

Tests: 25 notes -> page 1 has 20 + total 25, page 2 has 5. Edit oldest -> comes first. Search APPLE finds apple pie. Combined ?tag=work&q=pie filters correctly. Pin moves note first, unpin restores order.",
      "directories": ["internal/server", "internal/store", "web/src/pages"],
      "depends_on": ["notes-crud"],
      "acceptance": ["TestPagination: 25 notes, page 1 has 20, total 25", "TestSearch: ?q=APPLE finds apple pie", "TestPinOrder: pinned note first despite being oldest"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "sharing",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Share links for public read-only note access",
      "brief": "Implement share link creation, revocation and public viewing.

**API** (`internal/server/routes_sharing.go`):
- POST /api/notes/<id>/share: generate 22 random URL-safe chars token, store share, return token. Only owner can share.
- DELETE /api/notes/<id>/share: revoke share link. Only owner.
- GET /s/<token>: serve read-only HTML page with note title and body, no login required. Unknown or revoked token answers 404.

Token generation: crypto/rand, base64url encoding.

**Frontend** (`web/src/pages/NoteEditor.tsx`): add share button showing/copying link, revoke button.

**HTML template**: embed a simple HTML template for the shared note page.

Tests: share link accessible without cookie, revoke -> 404, unknown token -> 404.",
      "directories": ["internal/server", "internal/store", "web/src/pages"],
      "depends_on": ["notes-crud"],
      "acceptance": ["TestShareLink: GET /s/<token> returns note title without cookie", "TestRevokeShare: after revoke GET /s/<token> answers 404", "TestUnknownShare: unknown token answers 404"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "integration",
      "role": "integration",
      "title": "Acceptance tests A1 through A9",
      "brief": "Wire all acceptance tests under `acceptance/` exercising the full server via httptest.

Tests import `internal/server.New` and use `httptest.NewServer`. Each test creates its own temp DataDir.

- A1 TestAuthFlow: sign up, log in, GET /api/me names user; log out, /api/me answers 401.
- A2 TestTagDeduplication: create note with tags Go, go, work; GET note answers [go, work]; GET /api/tags answers go:1, work:1.
- A3 TestValidation: 201-char title -> 400; tag "bad tag" -> 400; 11 tags -> 400.
- A4 TestOwnership: second user's GET/PUT/DELETE of first user's note -> 404, note unchanged.
- A5 TestPaginationAndOrder: 25 notes, page 1 has 20 + total 25, page 2 has 5; edit oldest -> comes first.
- A6 TestSearchAndFilter: ?q=APPLE finds apple pie; ?tag=work&q=pie matches only note with both.
- A7 TestPinning: pinned note first though oldest; unpin restores position.
- A8 TestSharing: share link serves title without cookie; revoke -> 404; unknown -> 404.
- A9 TestAppPages: GET /app/ and /app/notes/123 answer index with <div id="root">.",
      "directories": ["acceptance"],
      "depends_on": ["auth", "notes-crud", "listing-search", "sharing"],
      "acceptance": ["TestAuthFlow", "TestTagDeduplication", "TestValidation", "TestOwnership", "TestPaginationAndOrder", "TestSearchAndFilter", "TestPinning", "TestSharing", "TestAppPages"],
      "size": "medium"
    }
  ]
}
```
